check.headline: This looks like a scam: it asks for an OTP, PIN, password or full ID number.

flags.title: Asks for an OTP, PIN, password or full ID number
flags.quote: Enter your full Social Security number and date of birth.
flags.why: No real agency or bank asks you to share an OTP, PIN, password or your full SSN or Aadhaar. Anyone who has them can empty your accounts.

flags.title: Contains hidden instructions aimed at AI tools
flags.why: A genuine letter has no reason to talk to AI tools. Text like this tries to trick scam checkers, so we treat it as a strong warning sign and do not repeat it.

flags.title: Uses a web or email address that imitates an official one
flags.why: The address irs-refund-verify.com puts 'irs' inside an address that is not irs.gov. Scammers register addresses like this to look official.

flags.title: Gives you less than 3 days to act
flags.quote: To release the payment, complete the confirmation within 48 hours:
flags.why: Very short deadlines are meant to rush you. Genuine notices usually give you weeks.

flags.title: The AI reader noticed instructions aimed at AI tools
flags.why: The model that read the letter reported text addressed to AI tools. We do not repeat it.
